verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no specifics on CPU or wall-clock execution time limits for Vercel functions; docs items are generic feature blurbs without concrete numbers, and no community or docs evidence addresses duration/CPU caps for agentic or long-running workloads. missing for 10: documented per-plan execution time limits, CPU time limits, and any guidance on suitability for long-running/agentic workloads.
